params.name: steps
params.meaning: flow-matching denoise steps (SamplerCustomAdvanced takes the sigmas from BasicScheduler, scheduler 'simple')
params.interactions: template note: '50 inference steps just take too long ... by default we set the step to 20 steps. If you want a better quality, please try the original settings'; CFG-distilled 'must use 50 steps to generate correct results'

params.name: cfg
params.meaning: classifier-free guidance; at 1.0 ComfyUI skips the unconditional pass (the negative prompt is unused)
params.interactions: cfg 6 on a distilled file over-guides

params.name: shift
params.meaning: flow shift of the sigma schedule
params.interactions: DISAGREEMENT recorded: the T2V template runs shift 7 where Tencent's table says 9 for 720p T2V ('Please strictly follow the configuration below to guarantee the best generation results'); the recipe ships the template value and exposes the port

params.name: length
params.meaning: pixel frames; latent frames = (length-1)//4+1; node step 4 -> 4n+1
params.interactions: 121 = 5 s @24 fps; any other value makes the reference CLI warn 'Attempting to generate {n} frames...'; docs: '5-10 second videos' (10 s 720p is the SSTA benchmark)

params.name: fps
params.interactions: a different container fps changes playback speed

params.name: width / height

defaults.480p models: NOT FOUND exactly in Comfy terms (CLI '--resolution 480p --aspect_ratio 16:9'); node default 848x480

params.interactions: 480p file + 720p SR is the cheaper 720p path (no template)

params.name: noise_augmentation (SR)
params.meaning: noise added to the upscaled latent before the SR pass
params.interactions: Tencent guidance NOT FOUND; the template splits the 8-step SR schedule at step 4 ('Split at matching sigma to the noise scale'): first half SR conditioning + fresh noise (seed 889), second half DisableNoise + the plain text conditioning

params.name: SR target size
params.meaning: resamples the latent to (W/16, H/16) then model.resample_latent; step 8; 0 keeps aspect
params.interactions: 720->1080 with hunyuanvideo15_latent_upsampler_1080p; 480->720 with _720p + the 720p SR model (6 steps)

params.name: tiled decode
params.meaning: tiled video VAE decode ('Use the VAE Decode (Tiled) if it takes too long')
params.interactions: Tencent ComfyUI README: 'If you enable the Tiled VAE decoding node, please set the temporal_size to the maximum value (4096) to avoid generating artifacts' - the T2V template's bypassed node still carries 8

params.name: weight_dtype
params.meaning: on-load quantisation of the fp16 file
params.interactions: template note: 'If you don't have enough VRAM and encounter the OOM error, please try to set the weight_dtype to fp8_e4n3fn' (sic: fp8_e4m3fn); or load the _fp8_scaled files

params.name: EasyCache
params.interactions: 'EasyCache can speed up this workflow, but it will also sacrifice the video quality' - not in the recipes

params.name: seed
params.meaning: main-pass noise; the SR stage has its own RandomNoise (template 889) then DisableNoise for the second half

rules.message: HunyuanVideo 1.5 text encoding is DualCLIPLoader with type 'hunyuan_video_15' (Qwen2.5-VL + ByT5 glyph); 'hunyuan_video' is the 1.0 tokenizer and 'kandinsky5' the Kandinsky one
clip_name1 is Qwen2.5-VL 7B (qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled, template; or the 16.6 GB full file)
clip_name2 is the ByT5-small glyph encoder (byt5_small_glyphxl_fp16) that gives 1.5 its bilingual in-video text

every 1.5 model (incl. the SR models) decodes with hunyuanvideo15_vae_fp16 (32-ch, 16x spatial, 4x temporal); the HunyuanVideo 1.0 VAE hunyuan_video_vae_bf16 (16-ch, 8x) is a different latent space (it is the Kandinsky 5 VAE)
1.5 frame counts are 4n+1 (latent frames = (length-1)//4+1; node step 4): 121 = 5 s @24 fps; the reference CLI warns for anything but 121
the reference CLI default is 121 frames and it warns 'Attempting to generate {n} frames...' for any other value; docs promise 5-10 s but only 121 is the tested length
1.5 latent nodes take width/height in multiples of 16 (16x spatial VAE)
the 720p models were run at 1280x720 by the templates; the 480p models' exact Comfy size is NOT FOUND (node default 848x480, CLI '480p 16:9'); other sizes are untested here
the SR latent upscale node steps width/height by 8 (0 keeps aspect); template 1920x1080
a 720p file is paired with a 720p latent (1280x720) in the templates; 480p files are a separate set of checkpoints - do not run a 720p file at 480p or the reverse (settings table is per resolution)
every distilled 1.5 checkpoint (CFG-distilled, step-distilled, SR) runs at cfg 1; 'Using cfg 6 on a distilled file over-guides' - the SR CFGGuiders in the template are both 1
'The cfg distilled model we provided, must use 50 steps to generate correct results' (Tencent) - the template's 20-step shortcut does not apply to it
the 480p I2V step-distilled model is for '8 or 12 steps (recommended)'; 4 works 'with slightly reduced quality'; 20 or 50 wastes its distillation
Tencent: step-distilled 480p I2V runs at shift 7 (not the 480p base's 5)
Tencent's table: 480p T2V/I2V (and their CFG-distilled twins) use flow shift 5
720p T2V: the template runs shift 7, Tencent's table says 9 ('strictly follow the configuration ... to guarantee the best generation results') - both recorded; stay between them
720p I2V: shift 7 in both the template and Tencent's table (and the ComfyUI model default)
shift 2 is the SR models' schedule (HunyuanVideo15_SR_Distilled default 2.0); a generation model under shift 2 is off-distribution
720->1080 SR: 8 steps (template splits them 4/4 with SplitSigmas); 480->720 SR: 6 steps

the 1080p SR model works on a latent first resampled by hunyuanvideo15_latent_upsampler_1080p (HunyuanVideo15LatentUpscaleWithModel) and conditioned by HunyuanVideo15SuperResolution (98-channel concat latent); the 720p SR model pairs with _720p

an SR model expects HunyuanVideo15SuperResolution's (2C+2)-channel concat latent (upscaled latent + flag channel + optional encoded start image); feeding it a plain latent gives the in_channels 98 mismatch

the fp8_scaled 1080p SR file with the fp16 VAE raised 'Expected tensor to have size 98 at dimension 1, but got size 64' in the stock template (HF repack #5, unresolved, single source) - use the fp16 SR file, or verify first
HunyuanVideo15ImageToVideo without start_image is a T2V graph with the wrong node: wire the image (or use EmptyHunyuanVideo15Latent)
the node accepts clip_vision_output as optional, but the template and the model (vision_in_dim 1152) use SigLIP: CLIPVisionLoader(sigclip_vision_patch14_384) -> CLIPVisionEncode crop 'center'
the I2V node is paired with an _i2v_ checkpoint in the template; the original transformers are 'per task' - a T2V file with image conditioning is NOT FOUND

'If you enable the Tiled VAE decoding node, please set the temporal_size to the maximum value (4096) to avoid generating artifacts' (Tencent ComfyUI README); the T2V template's bypassed node still carries 8
1.5 generates at 24 fps (reference code fps=24); another container fps changes playback speed
'EasyCache can speed up this workflow, but it will also sacrifice the video quality' - the templates ship it bypassed
the lightx2v 4-step LoRA was trained for 480p T2V (a 720p version is requested, not published - HF repack #4); community settings only: strength ~0.5, 6-8 steps, lower shift, cfg 1 (#2)
both templates need ComfyUI >= 0.3.71, below the pinned 0.35.0; nothing pending for version

prompting.negative_note: the official default negative is EMPTY (generate.py --negative_prompt '' ; both templates ''); at cfg 1 (distilled / SR) a negative is unused anyway

positive.line: T2V core formula (official handbook): 'Prompt = Subject + Motion + Scene + [Shot Type] + [Camera Movement] + [Lighting] + [Style] + [Atmosphere]' ('Basic Usage: Subject + Motion + Scene'; 'Advanced Usage: Freely add more control tags')

I2V core formula: 'Prompt = Subject Motion Dynamics + Scene Motion Dynamics + [Camera Movement]' - 'The first frame of the video comes from the uploaded image, while the content of subsequent frames will be generated according to the text prompt'

Longer is better: 'By writing longer and more detailed prompts, the generated video will be significantly improved. We encourage you to craft comprehensive and descriptive prompts'; the reference pipeline rewrites prompts with an LLM by default (--rewrite) and warns of 'lower quality video generation' without it - ComfyUI has no rewriter, so write the long form yourself

Camera Movement Library (verbatim phrases the model follows): 'The camera moves upward/downward', 'The camera moves to the left/right', 'The camera moves forward' (dolly in), 'The camera moves back' (dolly out), 'The camera tilts up/down', 'The camera pans to the left/right', 'The camera circles around', 'The camera rotates 360 degrees', 'The camera follows', 'The camera remains static'

Style keywords: photorealistic/cinematic, Film Noir, cyberpunk, Low-Poly 3D, Chinese ink wash 'Xieyi style', 2D animation, watercolor; lighting control: style, direction, light quality, shadow details, colour temperature, reflections, silhouettes
In-video text: put the exact words in quotes - examples render "Hunyuan Video 1.5" and "混元视频 1.5"; Chinese and English are supported (glyph-aware ByT5 encoder)

Template T2V example (verbatim): 'A paper airplane released from the top of a skyscraper, gliding through urban canyons, crossing traffic, flying over streets, spiraling upward between buildings. The camera follows the paper airplane's perspective, shooting cityscape in first-person POV, finally flying toward the sunset, disappearing in golden light. Creative camera movement, free perspective, dreamlike colors.'
'Strong instruction following for camera movements, physics, and emotional expressions'; 'Supports diverse styles (realistic, anime, 3D)'

prompting.structure: Subject + Motion + Scene, then shot type, one camera-movement phrase from the library, lighting, style, atmosphere - one detailed paragraph; for I2V describe only what moves (subject, scene, camera), not what the image already shows

hurts.line: short prompts without the reference pipeline's rewriter: 'may result in lower quality video generation'
re-describing the start image in I2V (the handbook formula is motion + camera only)
relying on a negative prompt at cfg 1 (distilled / SR recipes): it is skipped

pitfalls.cause: VAEDecodeTiled temporal_size below 4096 (the T2V template's bypassed node carries 8)
pitfalls.fix: temporal_size 4096 (official ComfyUI README); the I2V and SR tiled nodes already have it

pitfalls.symptom: soft / less faithful result than Tencent's samples
pitfalls.cause: the templates trade quality for time: 20 steps and shift 7 vs 50 steps and shift 9 (720p T2V)
pitfalls.fix: steps 50 (+ shift 9 for 720p T2V) through the recipe ports - 'Please strictly follow the configuration below to guarantee the best generation results'

pitfalls.symptom: over-guided / burnt output on a distilled file
pitfalls.cause: cfg 6 on a CFG-distilled, step-distilled or SR checkpoint
pitfalls.fix: cfg 1; CFG-distilled also needs 50 steps; step-distilled 8/12 steps at shift 7

pitfalls.cause: 16.7 GB fp16 model + 9.4 GB encoder at 720p x 121
pitfalls.fix: UNETLoader.weight_dtype fp8_e4m3fn (template note) or the _fp8_scaled files; VAEDecodeTiled (temporal 4096); 480p routes; reference code: 14 GB with offloading

pitfalls.symptom: 'Expected tensor to have size 98 at dimension 1, but got size 64' in the SR stage
pitfalls.cause: fp8_scaled 1080p SR file with the fp16 VAE in the stock template (HF repack #5, unresolved)

pitfalls.symptom: black 1920x1072 frames from the SR stage
pitfalls.cause: original / LightX2V-packaged SR weights, or a Comfy-Org SR file predating Kijai's 2025-11-26 fp8-scaling fix ('The SR model doesn't actually use the t_embedder layer ... made the scale_weight zeros too')
pitfalls.fix: use the Comfy-Org hunyuanvideo1.5_*_sr_distilled_* files; re-download if your copy predates 2025-11-26

pitfalls.cause: default strength/steps/shift with the lightx2v LoRA
pitfalls.fix: community (#2): strength ~0.5, 6-8 steps, lower shift, cfg 1; feed the first sampler's latent straight into HunyuanVideo15LatentUpscaleWithModel for a two-stage upscale - single-source, no recipe

pitfalls.symptom: I2V ignores the image or drifts
pitfalls.cause: start_image or clip_vision_output not wired; T2V weights used with the I2V node
pitfalls.fix: LoadImage -> HunyuanVideo15ImageToVideo.start_image and CLIPVisionEncode(center) -> clip_vision_output with sigclip_vision_patch14_384; use the _i2v_ file

pitfalls.symptom: 'Attempting to generate {n} frames...' warning / odd length

pitfalls.fix: leave it bypassed for finals ('sacrifice the video quality')

pitfalls.symptom: need audio, first+last frame, reference or editing
pitfalls.fix: another family (LTX-2 for audio; Wan 2.2 for FLF2V/VACE); OmniWeaving is not native in ComfyUI

pitfalls.symptom: licence question from an EU/UK/Korean user or a 100M-MAU product
pitfalls.cause: the Tencent Hunyuan Community License excludes the EU, UK and South Korea (works AND outputs) and caps MAU at 100 million without a Tencent licence
pitfalls.fix: do not offer this family there; see profile.license

pitfalls.cause: capybara_v0.1 is a third-party 14B derivative, not Tencent's 1.5 (consistency complaints, HF #8)
pitfalls.fix: treat it as a separate model; not covered by these recipes
